We learnt, too, that Alf, before he retired from running (?) was the forerunner of Wint. It is, perhaps, indicative of our new President's nature that he took up walking and left Wint a clear field.
In the 4 x 440 yds. our lads ran really well to qualify for the final seeing that the Poly had Wint and Laing, of Jamaica, running for them.
